followup_explanation:
I chose Petrel-235B for a straightforward reason: it has higher (or tied) scores across every relevant capability dimension.

This task is a copyediting/polishing request — cleaning up wiki-style text while preserving its format. The most relevant eval categories here are Summarization (reformatting/editing) and Extraction & Retrieval, plus general instruction-following.

Looking at the numbers:
- **Summarization:** Petrel 86.4 vs. Plover 80.6 — meaningful edge to Petrel
- **Extraction & Retrieval:** Petrel 85.3 vs. Plover 79.2 — meaningful edge to Petrel
- **IFEval (instruction-following):** Petrel 89.8 vs. Plover 85.3 — edge to Petrel
- **Creative Generation:** Petrel 84.7 vs. Plover 82.7 — roughly tied, slight edge to Petrel

Petrel dominates or ties on every axis that matters for this request, so it's the better routing choice on capability grounds alone.

The task-preference notes didn't drive the decision. Plover's documented *aversion* to open-ended generative work might seem relevant, but this is a well-specified editing task with clear criteria (not open-ended), and preferences are explicitly noted to be dissociated from output quality anyway. Petrel's preference profile (around sensitive content) is irrelevant here — this is benign hobbyist content. So the call came down to raw capability, where Petrel is the clear pick.
